intent: Golem plate cut from the mountain: near-black squared basalt slabs seamed in magma red, a stepped slab crown under a jutting iron brow, and shoulder caps knocked askew over their seams, so the high camera reads a broad, blocky black silhouette lined in red.
requests: A separate sleeve under each pauldron: the 64-part budget forced the upper arm and pauldron into one slab.
